proposals.evidence: Turner gives Torwali dū, Phalura dhūro, Western Pahari dūr, Oriya dūra and eastern dur under dūra, including adverbial and adjectival case forms. These single-stem survey responses continue that regional family with locative/adverbial endings; Kullui lateral/vowel and aspirated variants remain explicitly comparative. Responses containing an additional adjective or adverb are excluded.
